1.consolidated_definition: Compra cibernética. El término, que proviene de shopping y broadcasting, se refiere a la compra compartida en la que un grupo afín de internautas intercambian sus ideas de compras. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Ahora hacer compras por Internet es mucho más que mero consumo. Compañías como This Next y Style Hive ofrecen servicios de shopcasting, actividad cibernética en la cual los consumidores hacen listas de su hit parade de productos favoritos y las comparten con su cibercomunidad (El Nuevo Día, 01-10-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cyber shopping. The term, derived from shopping and broadcasting, refers to shared purchasing in which a group of like-minded internet users exchange their shopping ideas. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Now making purchases online is more than mere consumption. Companies such as This Next and Style Hive offer shopcasting services, a cyber activity in which consumers create lists of their favorite products and share them with their online community (The New Day, 01-10-06).
